title: 退換貨
description: 退貨與換貨的溝通用語

sentences.en: I would like to return this jacket, which I purchased online last week, because the size does not match the measurements listed.
sentences.zh: 我想退還上週在網上購買的這件外套，因為尺寸與所列的尺寸不符。

sentences.en: The product arrived with a noticeable defect on the surface, and I am requesting either a full refund or an immediate replacement.
sentences.zh: 產品到貨時表面有明顯瑕疵，我要求全額退款或立即更換。

sentences.en: Could you please explain your store's return policy regarding items that were purchased during the seasonal clearance sale?
sentences.zh: 您能否解釋貴店關於在季節性清倉特賣期間購買的商品的退貨政策？

sentences.en: Although I no longer have the original receipt, I can provide the order confirmation email as proof of purchase for this return.
sentences.zh: 雖然我不再有原始收據，但我可以提供訂單確認郵件作為此次退貨的購買證明。

sentences.en: The electronic device I received is not functioning as described in the product listing, which constitutes grounds for a warranty claim.
sentences.zh: 我收到的電子設備未按產品列表中的描述運作，這構成了保固索賠的理由。

sentences.en: I was told that exchanges for a different color or size could be processed within thirty days of the original purchase date.
sentences.zh: 我被告知可以在原始購買日期起三十天內處理換不同顏色或尺寸的商品。

sentences.en: Having opened the package carefully, I discovered that two of the items inside were damaged, apparently due to inadequate packaging.
sentences.zh: 小心地打開包裝後，我發現裡面有兩件物品損壞了，顯然是由於包裝不當。

sentences.en: The color of the shirt I received looks significantly different from what was displayed on your website when I placed the order.
sentences.zh: 我收到的襯衫顏色看起來與我下單時在你們網站上顯示的有很大不同。

sentences.en: I would appreciate it if you could expedite the refund process, as the charge has already appeared on my credit card statement.
sentences.zh: 如果您能加快退款流程，我將非常感激，因為這筆費用已經出現在我的信用卡帳單上了。

sentences.en: Since the item was a gift and I do not have a receipt, is it possible to receive store credit instead of a cash refund?
sentences.zh: 由於這件商品是禮物且我沒有收據，是否可以獲得商店積分而非現金退款？

sentences.en: The customer service representative informed me that restocking fees would apply to any opened electronics returned after the initial period.
sentences.zh: 客服代表告訴我，任何在初始期限後退回的已拆封電子產品將收取補貨費。

sentences.en: I am writing to dispute the denial of my return request, given that the product clearly does not match its advertised specifications.
sentences.zh: 我寫信對我的退貨請求被拒絕提出異議，因為產品明顯與其廣告規格不符。

sentences.en: Would it be possible to exchange this pair of shoes for a half-size larger, provided that the style is still available in your inventory?
sentences.zh: 如果這個款式在你們的庫存中仍有貨，是否可以將這雙鞋換成大半號的？

sentences.en: The appliance stopped working within the warranty period, so I expect the manufacturer to cover the cost of repair or replacement.
sentences.zh: 這台電器在保固期內就停止運作了，所以我期望製造商承擔維修或更換的費用。

sentences.en: I need to return several items from my recent online order, but the prepaid shipping label provided only covers a single package.
sentences.zh: 我需要退回最近網路訂單中的幾件商品，但提供的預付運費標籤只涵蓋一個包裹。

sentences.en: After waiting two weeks for the replacement to arrive, I have decided to cancel the exchange and request a full refund instead.
sentences.zh: 在等了兩週等待替換品到達後，我決定取消換貨，改為要求全額退款。

sentences.en: The manager assured me that once the returned item passes quality inspection, the refund would be credited within five business days.
sentences.zh: 經理向我保證，一旦退回的商品通過品質檢查，退款將在五個工作日內入帳。

sentences.en: I am disappointed that the return window has been shortened to fourteen days, as this hardly gives customers enough time to evaluate products.
sentences.zh: 我很失望退貨期限被縮短為十四天，因為這幾乎沒有給客戶足夠的時間評估產品。

sentences.en: Could you confirm whether I will be charged for return shipping, or if the company covers that cost for defective merchandise?
sentences.zh: 您能確認退貨運費是由我承擔，還是公司為有缺陷的商品承擔該費用？

sentences.en: The replacement unit you sent has the exact same problem as the original, which leads me to believe there is a systematic manufacturing defect.
sentences.zh: 你們寄來的替換品有和原來完全相同的問題，這讓我認為存在系統性的製造缺陷。

sentences.en: I purchased this item specifically because of the features advertised, none of which appear to function as the product description claimed.
sentences.zh: 我專門因為廣告中的功能而購買了這件商品，但這些功能似乎都沒有如產品描述所說的那樣運作。

sentences.en: Before initiating the return, I would like to know whether the promotional discount will still apply if I exchange for a different model.
sentences.zh: 在開始退貨之前，我想知道如果我換一個不同的型號，促銷折扣是否仍然適用。

sentences.en: The tracking information shows that my returned package was delivered to your warehouse a week ago, yet my refund has not been processed.
sentences.zh: 追蹤資訊顯示我退回的包裹一週前已送達你們的倉庫，但我的退款尚未處理。

sentences.en: Given that this is the third defective unit I have received, I am requesting a full refund along with compensation for the inconvenience caused.
sentences.zh: 鑑於這是我收到的第三個有缺陷的產品，我要求全額退款以及對所造成不便的補償。

sentences.en: I understand that customized items are typically non-returnable; however, the engraving contains a spelling error made by your staff.
sentences.zh: 我了解客製化商品通常不可退貨；然而，雕刻上有一個由你們員工造成的拼寫錯誤。

sentences.en: The store associate suggested that I contact the manufacturer directly for warranty claims, rather than processing the return through the retailer.
sentences.zh: 店員建議我直接聯繫製造商進行保固索賠，而不是透過零售商處理退貨。

sentences.en: I was charged the full price even though the item was marked as discounted, and I would like either a price adjustment or a complete return.
sentences.zh: 儘管商品標示為折扣價，我卻被收了全價，我希望能調整價格或完全退貨。

sentences.en: Please note that I am returning this product in its original packaging, unused and with all tags still attached, as required by your policy.
sentences.zh: 請注意，我按照你們的政策要求，以原始包裝、未使用且所有標籤仍附著的狀態退回此產品。

sentences.en: The online return portal keeps generating an error message whenever I attempt to submit my request, preventing me from completing the process.
sentences.zh: 每當我嘗試提交請求時，線上退貨入口一直產生錯誤訊息，使我無法完成退貨流程。

sentences.en: Since the product was delivered well past the estimated arrival date, I believe I am entitled to a refund of the expedited shipping charges.
sentences.zh: 由於產品的交付遠超過預估到達日期，我認為我有權獲得加急運費的退款。
